modal.$description: Centered modal dialog — native <dialog> with showModal(): free focus-trap, Escape-to-close, ::backdrop, top-layer rendering. Unlike Drawer, needs almost no positioning CSS at all — showModal()'s own UA stylesheet already centers a <dialog> via position:fixed + inset:0 + margin:auto, so this component only sets width/radius/shadow/padding on top of that native default. radius.xl specifically — already named for this exact case in radius's own legend ('Prominent surfaces: modals, large panels, hero cards'), not a new choice. Kept as a token file separate from Drawer per the same prior explicit decision (both are '<dialog> with showModal()' underneath, but centered-floating vs. edge-attached differ enough in sizing/radius/positioning to earn separate files). Nested modals (a modal opened from within another modal) 'just work' via the browser's own native top-layer stacking order — no z-index needed, unlike the manual modal-2/modal-overlay-2 tiers z-index.tokens.json defines for a non-native implementation. Four widths on a 160px step from sm, then a jump to xl (2026-10-26): sm 480 for confirmations, md 640 for forms, lg 800 for two-column forms or a list/table, xl 1200 for a working view (table, preview, editor). It used to be a single 384px (Tailwind's max-w-sm, inherited with no reason behind it) — too narrow for real modal content, which ranges from a one-line confirm to a full table. Every size is capped at the viewport minus 32px. Below breakpoint.sm (640) md/lg/xl render as Drawer's bottom placement — its shape (radius, shadow, max-height, slide-up) is read from drawer.tokens.json, never re-declared here, so fixing Drawer fixes this too. Still one Modal in code: CSS does the switch, developers never swap Modal for Drawer by screen size. sm stays centered on a phone: a short question reads as a question in the middle of the screen, from the bottom it reads like a menu (iOS/Android confirmations are centered too). AlertDialog (no ×, no outside-click, no Escape) is its own component since 2026-10-21 — alert-dialog.tokens.json. Header and footer are both optional composition, same as Card/Drawer — a Modal can be body-only. The close button and footer actions are real interactive elements with their own hover/active/focus states (the same fill.neutral/fill.neutralHover/fill.neutralActive/fill.primary or fill.danger recipe Button itself uses), not unstyled placeholders. Close (×) is a real Button — ghost, sm, icon-only (32×32, 16px icon) resolved from button.tokens.json — not a component-local recipe; it used to be a hand-sized 28px/18–20px copy of the same ghost colors (changed 2026-09-30).

sm.$description: 480px — confirmations, AlertDialog, short messages. Stays centered on a phone. Default.

md.$description: 640px — forms: a few fields, a date + time pick.

lg.$description: 800px — a two-column form, a list or a table of a few columns.

xl.$description: 1200px — a working view: a table, a preview, an editor. Close to the whole page.

viewportGutter.$description: 16px each side — every size is capped at 100vw − 32px.

breakpoint.$description: Below 640px md/lg/xl take Drawer's bottom placement; sm stays a centered card.

gap.$description: 12px — internal flex gap within the header row (title-to-close-button) and footer row (button-to-button), same reasoning as Drawer's own gap after the divider-width fix: section-to-section spacing comes from each section's own full padding, so the divider spans the whole modal width instead of sitting inset.

transitionDuration.$description: Literal, not a token, same precedent as Drawer/Tooltip. Slightly quicker than Drawer's 250ms — a centered scale/fade reads fine faster than an edge slide covering more distance.

title.$description: 18px semibold — a modal title should read as a genuine dialog heading, sitting between a page/app title (20px+) and body/label text. heading-base (14px) read too small in practice.

description.$description: Optional line under the title (Radix Dialog.Description, wired to aria-describedby) — one sentence of context a screen reader reads right after the title on open. Same recipe as Card's description. Added 2026-10-26.
